text_block_list.text: A large red-and-white striped tent came into view. As I pulled out my ticket with growing excitement, the scent of butter drifted in from somewhere, tickling my nose.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Shall I take your hand? Lost little lamb.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did that tickle? Sorry, your cute ears were right there, and I couldn’t 
resist teasing you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The venue is just ahead! Are you ready to have a buono time?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I’ll make sure you’re completely full and satisfied!! Come on, let’s go!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Probieren Sie! Sweet and rich like stollen――

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Even if bad stuff happens? Like, you know? Expect an awesome time that’ll flip your mood around.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hey, it’s right there! Can you see it too? Can you hear it?――The feeling of a huge marvelous is coming☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha☆ Welcome! To the ‘Delicious☆Marvelous★Circus!!’
Event title logo displayed.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: When I was still little, the circus came to town!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: There were so many stalls lined up! It was already marvelous before the show even began☆ The smell of popcorn, kids’ excited voices, colorful balloons!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ――And once inside, it was packed with heart-pounding excitement!! The performers, knowing the risks, still――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: They flew through the air. They danced midair.――All for the smiles of the audience. There was a marvelous born only from polishing the desire to entertain☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, my heart kept pounding☆ I was so surprised so many times! And then I thought! Someday, I want to be like that too――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That’s why, I want to challenge it☆ At the Seitei-sai, with a circus!!!!

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: ……I’m sorry, Marvelous. I understand your passion very well, but... in the end, the teachers didn’t grant permission.

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: A circus might not be possible at this time……!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhhhhhh!!!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see... Could you tell us why permission wasn’t granted? Please share the specific reasons.

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: Yes. The major points were... ‘staffing’ and ‘safety.’ These two were flagged as concerns――

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: ……At this scale, there’s no precedent. So the worry is that without enough staff, it may collapse midway... and then there’s…

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: Regarding safety――most of the acts involve risks that could lead to injuries if they fail. We cannot approve a program that would make fans anxious at a fan appreciation festival.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. Then, if we clear those two issues, it’ll be fine☆

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: W-well. Theoretically yes! But... it’s not something easily done, you know?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! Of course I know it won’t be easy! But――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The true marvelous lies beyond that☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It might be hard. It might be impossible. But overturning that is what makes it Marvelous☆ So let’s do it!!!

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: …A-alright. I’ll try to support you however I can toward making it real!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thanks～! Alright! Then first, let’s gather our comrades! Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ughhh... no way. Losing a nail... that was one of my main lineup, you know～～～!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Don’t be too down. I’ll help look later too. Let’s check around the cafeteria next.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... thanks, Flash... When I’m at my limit, you’re like, number one in the ‘Uma Musume I want by my side’ ranking, right? Seriously... huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more time. When I snap my fingers... now!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh!? What was that!? Seriously, how’d you do that!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here you go～! …Wait? Wasn’t this carrot flavor? Then, this one? …Or maybe this one?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, what the!? Is your pocket another dimension or something!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yes! Thanks for the clapping☆ Here we goooooo, take this★☆★

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! You can do that!? Never seen that even on Umatokku!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Everyone～, thanks for watching today～♪ Actually, we’re doing a circus at the Seitei-sai too～.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I’d be really happy if you thought, ‘I want to join too～.’ Here! Take a flyer～!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ………Ah! Before I knew it, I was completely absorbed.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: See～～～? That was kinda fun! Plus, it boosted my mood! Instantly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …A circus, huh. Haha, sounds pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So yeah, count me in～! Let’s blow the roof off with the circus! Woo～☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yessss☆ Jordan’s joining us too! …Hey hey, Flash～? Let’s do the circus together★☆★

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Yes, I suppose so. It seems there will be many problems, but... I believe it’s a performance that has the power to entertain others.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Actually, I also remembered… Fastnacht. The excitement I felt when I saw the carnival back home. So――

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It may be small, but I’d like to lend my help.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Wait. Wait, please. You haven’t even gotten approval yet? ‘Staffing’? ‘Safety’? Only after handling those?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah. First, solve those issues, and then we can hold the circus!――Let’s work hard together, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Yes. Since I’ve accepted, I’ll definitely see it through. I plan to treat achieving the goal as mandatory and set a detailed schedule, but――

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ………Streng dich an!
